pullbackCandidate.scale: Existing causal priorClose*S; fixed 0.5S reversal threshold unchanged
pullbackCandidate.segment: Same symbol/session/AM-or-PM; exactly adjacent complete 5m bars; reset on any missing bar or phase/session boundary
pullbackCandidate.impulse: Confirmed upward swing direction=+1, from trough to peak
pullbackCandidate.correction: Immediately following confirmed downward swing direction=-1 in the same uninterrupted segment, sharing the impulse peak as its anchor
pullbackCandidate.value: downward correction amplitude / immediately preceding upward impulse amplitude; denominator strictly positive; no clipping of ratios above1
pullbackCandidate.availability: Only at downward swing's later upward-reversal confirmation, never at its earlier trough/extremeAt
pullbackCandidate.multipleEvents: Retain all event records; per-session scalar is arithmetic mean of eligible pairs. nEventPairs, event-bearing sessions and effective sessions stored separately; no new inference independence claim
pullbackCandidate.missing: No confirmed eligible pair => null, never zero; unconfirmed terminal correction excluded
pullbackCandidate.scope: Correct cross-phase adjacency and explicitly define LONG direction. No new search, threshold change or automatic replacement of v0
pullbackCandidate.remeasurement: Not in this task; separate bounded Development-only precommit must preserve v0 comparator and unchanged Gate

readerCandidate.history: Canonical explicit session=original daily.Date. Reject missing/duplicate/nonincreasing dates or date>=current session. Adapter explicitly converts barValue integer keys to canonical barValues integer keys; never guesses a missing session or silently aliases malformed data
readerCandidate.minuteTimestamp: 1m bar start time, JST; bar starting m becomes available at m+1
readerCandidate.closed5m: At decision minute t, only complete five consecutive observed 1m bars in [e-5,e) with e<=t. No zero-fill, forward-fill, missing/lunch bridges or terminal auction substitution
readerCandidate.decisionDomain: 09:05..11:30 and12:35..regularClose, inclusive. regularClose=15:00 before2024-11-05,15:25 thereafter. Outside domain return UNAVAILABLE_OUTSIDE_CONTINUOUS_PHASE
readerCandidate.expectedEnd: floor(t/5)*5 inside active phase; lastCompletedBar must equal expectedEnd
readerCandidate.freshness: Both expectedEnd equality and 0<=t-lastCompletedBar<=4 required. Missing latest complete bar => UNAVAILABLE_MISSING_CURRENT_BAR even if older bar age appears acceptable. No morning context at afternoon start
readerCandidate.boundaries: Reset swing/contiguity at missing bars, lunch and session boundary; previous daily must be exact preceding allowed exchange session with verified calendar provenance or unavailable
readerCandidate.missing: Reason-coded null features; no silent fresh status. No eligible scale or prior daily => UNAVAILABLE. Partial history insufficient for volume baseline => null RVOL with reason, not synthetic zero
readerCandidate.personality: computed_through strictly before current session; preserve as-of/definition/units and separately versioned freshness policy. Do not join old daily snapshot as if current. Require explicit mapping between wick/range and wick/S; conditional future response profiles never become contemporaneous known outcomes
